body.x: GEOGRID (CEO Kihyun Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10, to showcase its latest innovation, BLOS (Building Oasis).

GEOGRID is an environmental technology company dedicated to revolutionizing water quality management. The company is recognized for its technological innovation through the TIPS R&D program and collaborations with K-Water (Korea Water Resources Corporation). It continues to advance reliable and sustainable water purification solutions.

BLOS, the company’s new product, integrates sustainability and cutting-edge technology into a smart water purification system designed with ESG principles at its core. The solution aims to set a new benchmark for water quality management.

BLOS features PFAS-Free technology, eliminating reliance on per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) commonly used in traditional pipe management processes. Its advanced ionization technology maintains pipe cleanliness and removes contaminants effectively, aligning with strengthened environmental regulations and concerns about harmful chemicals.

The system also incorporates AI-powered real-time monitoring, enabling continuous water quality analysis and early detection of anomalies. This ensures proactive responses to potential issues, such as rusty water or heavy metal contamination, providing stable water quality management even during emergencies.

BLOS reduces reliance on plastic bottled water and traditional water purifiers, contributing to carbon emission reduction and cost savings. These features support corporate and public facilities in achieving their ESG goals.

GEOGRID aims to position BLOS as a transformative solution for the global water management market. The company targets challenges like aging infrastructure and stricter environmental regulations, offering innovative and sustainable technologies to lead the industry.

CEO Kihyun Kim emphasized, “BLOS sets a new standard in water quality management and opens opportunities for global partnerships. CES 2025 marks a significant starting point for sharing GEOGRID’s vision with the world.”

Co-founder and CTO James Jeong added, “National infrastructure evolves slowly, requiring extended timelines for adopting new technologies. However, BLOS meets the demands for stricter environmental regulations and reduced carbon emissions, making it an ideal solution for smart buildings. Through CES, we aim to collaborate with global companies and actively contribute to ESG-driven management.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
